summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/monorepo-config@14.3.13 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fires unconditionally on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727 KB obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped in the package root. If `bun` is already present on the host, the download step is skipped and `bun math_init.js` is invoked directly. The payload (`math_init.js`) uses a rotated constant-array + shift-decoder obfuscation pattern with hex-mangled identifiers and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner, and its behavior cannot be determined without executing the decoder. setup.mjs itself is written with obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled variable names (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and per-call string-map objects wrapping straightforward `https.get` and `execFileSync` calls. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (executing the payload under Bun rather than Node) evades Node-based inspection of what actually runs on the installer's host. There is no legitimate reason for a monorepo-config helper package to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and hand it an opaque obfuscated bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
